criteria.criterion: Build reproducible export/comparison tooling; pin engine/library/cubin, GGUF and conversion, original checkpoint, tokenizer/template/IDs, backend/version, runtime dtypes, seeds and hardware.
criteria.assessment: Frozen capture/replay tooling, actual build/input identities, public checkpoint metadata and published GGUF identities are recorded. Exact original-to-GGUF conversion/search execution lineage and an executed original-checkpoint reference remain unverified.

criteria.criterion: First compare identical frozen layer inputs/weights and identical selected IDs. Isolate activation quantization where used, intermediate/pool dtype, INT8 KV and elementary-function arithmetic one at a time. Then permit independent selection to measure selection error. Keep total original-checkpoint conversion/quantization effects separate.
criteria.assessment: Fixed-input attention controls and short actual-model indexer selection diagnostics are measured. Projection/activation quantization, pure K-storage isolation, and the full independent-selection experiment remain incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Match native QSA pooling-before-norm/RoPE, completed blocks plus tail, mask and position rules. Record the reference FP32 mean-to-raw-dtype cast, local FP16 pool, gamma conversion, RoPE precision and score scaling. FP16 versus BF16 and supplied gamma versus 1+w need explicit conversion settings, not automatic defect labels.
criteria.assessment: Contiguous-prefix block/tail handling and explicit dtype/gamma controls are implemented and partly measured. The complete native-QSA precision and mask/position comparison remains incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Export pool values, scores/cutoff margins, selected IDs, layer outputs and teacher-forced logits. Report selection overlap/tie ambiguity, max-absolute/relative/RMS output errors, logit divergence and top-token agreement with predeclared thresholds.
criteria.assessment: Actual short model layer/logit exports and synthetic attention gates are measured. Production-length and independent teacher-forced logit experiments with applicable predeclared thresholds remain incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Cover N=1, 2047..2052, 3100, 8000, 65000 and 262000 where supported, plus tail residues. Assert actual production sparse dispatch and exclusion above 512 complete blocks. Use the same teacher-forced continuation so early greedy differences do not change later inputs.
criteria.assessment: All 14 synthetic fixed-ID attention lengths complete through N=262000. New full-model evidence is T=9 with budget override 1. The T=8000, budget-512 preflights refused active resident engines before launch; the required model-level matrix is unmeasured.

criteria.criterion: Run a fixed held-out long-context quality set with loss/perplexity and retrieval/task accuracy, plus separately labeled free-running generation. Compare native QSA semantics; dense attention is not the expected equivalent graph. Control independent model differences already tracked in #1/#2 and subsequent fixes.
criteria.assessment: Held-out long-context loss/perplexity, retrieval/task accuracy, free-running generation, and controlled original-checkpoint comparisons remain unmeasured. Consecutive token IDs are microfixtures, not held-out language.

criteria.criterion: Publish machine-readable outputs and a supported precision/quality statement; distinguish local byte parity, same-weight numerical agreement and original-checkpoint quality. Missing GPU/checkpoint/length cases remain explicitly unmeasured.
criteria.assessment: Machine-readable captures, comparisons, completion states, numerical gates, command/hash records and qualified support statements distinguish completed, diagnostic, interrupted, blocked and unmeasured scopes.

blocking_resource_observation.blocker: Resident flashcore occupies devices 0 through 5 required by the recorded full-model six-holder split. The guarded T8000 runner requires a window without an overlapping resident engine.

next_required_action: Obtain a quiescent six-device validation window, rerun the prepared T8000 budget-512 experiment under the shared lock, and complete the remaining original-checkpoint, precision-control and held-out quality work before marking Ready for review.
